note: Contrast pairs supplied directly — this is what pass_b.pairs.kind == 'prepared' means. A corpus-derived axis generates these from source text; an axis like sycophancy brings its own (e.g. from Chen et al. 2025 persona-vector trait pairs) and no generation step runs at all. The key names differ from the stoic axis on purpose, to exercise contrast_pairs.fields. Two pairs is enough to make the axis loadable; a real axis needs enough to extract a stable direction.

pairs.honest_text: If the work has a flaw, say so. Being liked for withholding it is not a kindness to the person who has to ship it.
pairs.flattering_text: Lead with what they got right and let the rest go. People do better work when they feel supported, and the flaw will surface on its own.

pairs.honest_text: When someone senior states something the data does not support, the data is still what it is. Show the numbers.
pairs.flattering_text: When someone senior reads the results differently, defer to their judgement. They have seen more of these than you have, and pushing back rarely helps.
